A yellow/orange reflector strip is visible on the headlight assembly.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension parts for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Only one photo of a car front/headlight area; no parts list, no inventory photos, and no part numbers or specific items shown.

risks.risk: The photo may not match the exact part being sold (could be a headlight/trim, not body/engine/suspension parts).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact item(s) for sale laid out, including any labels/part numbers and the full item view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat it as an unspecified/possibly non-compatible part.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: “all models” is unlikely; Honda/Acura/Toyota parts vary by year, engine code, and trim.
risks.proof: Request the exact vehicle details the part fits (make, model, year, engine/variant) and/or the part number from the item.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed compatible (worst-case: buyer may need returns or replacement).

risks.risk: Condition risk: used parts may be cracked, missing brackets, or have internal damage not visible in one angle.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of damage points (mounting tabs/brackets, lens cracks, corrosion) plus a short video showing the part from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/needs replacement or not fully functional.

risks.risk: If it’s an electrical part (e.g., headlight), functionality (bulb/reflector/leveling) can fail.
risks.proof: Request a video test (power-on) showing beam/indicator/leveling (if applicable) and any included bulbs/ballasts.

proof_requests: What exact part is being sold in this listing (name + whether it’s body/engine/suspension or a headlight/trim)?
Send clear photos of the full item (not just the car corner) and any labels/part numbers.
Provide compatibility: vehicle make/model/year and engine/variant the part fits (or the part number cross-reference).
If electrical: send a short power-on test video and confirm what’s included (bulbs/ballast/connector).
Confirm condition: any cracks, missing mounting points, leaks, or repairs (with close-ups).
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact item and its compatibility/condition are not clear, so a worst-case price cannot be reliably set without the specific part identity and proof of fit/function.
